title: Tommy P NDE 6572
content: This is pretty simple experience. It happened at night. After a few hours in a blackout, I saw myself flying in the sky. Then I was inside myself, flying, and I began to see things on the ground below. From, like, four hundred feet up in the air, I saw streets, I saw a soccer field and a basketball court, and then I saw the hospital. I was very familiar with the locations of all these landmarks. Then, from up there, I saw a blue car, an old Dodge Dart taxi, driving up to the entrance of the hospital. What I remember the most is watching the beam of the taxi's headlights on the ground as it moved closer and closer to the entrance of the little hospital's emergency room. Then I felt myself free falling for a second. I opened my eyes, physically, and I saw the faces of my mom and dad. They were transporting me in the back seat of a car. That's where I woke up, in the back seat of the car. Then, through the car's window, I saw the hospital's entrance. I remembered what I had just seen while I was flying, so I stuck my head through the open window and saw that it was the same blue car I had just seen from the sky, and it was in the same location! I got so scared and so confused that I fainted again. One more blackout. The next day, I woke up at home.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Flying in the sky, about four hundred feet up, observing streets, a soccer field, a basketball court, and the hospital from above.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Brief free-fall sensation before opening eyes physically.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Narrative mentions 'a few hours in a blackout' and being transported to a hospital, but no cause is specified.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed ground landmarks and a blue taxi (old Dodge Dart) approaching the hospital entrance from an aerial vantage; then regained physical awareness in a car; later confirmed the taxi/location through the car window.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackout → flying/OBE observing landmarks and taxi → brief free-fall → opened eyes physically in back seat of car → saw hospital entrance and confirmed the blue taxi → fear/confusion and fainted again → woke up next day at home.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple blackouts/fainting episodes occurred (initial blackout, then fainted again after confirming the taxi).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Aerial observation of a specific blue taxi (old Dodge Dart) and its headlight beam approaching the hospital entrance, later seemingly confirmed from the car window upon regaining physical consciousness.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “From, like, four hundred feet up in the air, I saw streets, I saw a soccer field and a basketball court, and then I saw the hospital.”
